SWEET SEPTEMBER, as fifth emergency needs luck to gain a start but she can make her presence felt if she does take her place in this field. FLYING VENTO has trialed twice since a spell and he's now ready to tackle this short journey on debut. TALEIKA trialed midway through July at Grafton in preparation for this debut attempt today. She has the pace to make her own luck in transit.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 4, 11, 13, 16. KEEP IT LOKI displayed great determination to score when he tackled this journey last start at the Gold Coast and with gear changes made this afternoon, he can further progress. BARELLO can be forgiven for unplaced efforts since a spell at Grafton and then at Doomben when he makes his Casino debut today. BIANCO NERO found the line with no dangers after leading over this journey at Inverell when she was produced third up in her first campaign since a stable change. She can maintain her form today. DARK CHILL had too much to do when he was resuming last start at Grafton. He will be more suitably placed this afternoon at his home base, second up.
